raw_context:
Zones
sells
enterprise information technology (IT) hardware, software, data center infrastructure, and professional IT services
. They supply over 150,000 tech products from major brands like Apple, Cisco, Microsoft, HP, and Dell to businesses, government agencies, and healthcare organizations.
Zones
Hardware and Devices
Client Devices:
AI PCs, desktops, all-in-ones, notebooks, tablets, and thin clients.
Peripherals:
Monitors, projectors, professional audiovisual (ProAV) solutions, and headsets.
Printing & Supplies:
Printers, scanners, and ink or toner supplies.
Data Center & Infrastructure:
Enterprise servers, storage arrays, flash drives, and tape libraries.
Zones
Software and Security
Business & Productivity:
Collaboration tools, creative publishing platforms, and general business applications.
Data Protection:
Backup, recovery, and asset management software.
Cybersecurity:
Firewalls, endpoint protection, and network security applications.
Zones
IT Services and Solutions
Managed Services:
Cloud management, workplace management, and security operations.
Professional Services:
Consulting, system design, hardware configuration, and deployment.
Staffing:
Flexible and project-based IT staffing solutions.
